players.product: Power Systems division: backup engines and gas engines for prime power at data centres; next-generation engine to replace the Series 4000, targeting the data centre market with increased power density (launch 2028)

quarterly_data.signal: DoD award: modification P00011 to contract W56HZV-23-C-0054 with Rolls-Royce Solutions America Inc. (Novi, Michigan) to procure Eitan power packs, funded by Foreign Military Sales (Israel) funds; brings total cumulative face value to $158,903,171; work in Graniteville, South Carolina, estimated completion Sept. 11, 2027; contracting activity Army Contracting Command, Detroit Arsenal, Michigan. (A DoD correction on Sept. 24, 2026 gave the award date as Sept. 23, 2026.)
